Usage: protonvpn countries [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Discover all countries where Proton VPN servers are available.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list  List all countries where Proton VPN servers are available.

  Output:
    Displays country names with their two-letter codes and server counts.
  
  Examples:
    protonvpn countries list
  
  Connect to a country:
    protonvpn connect --country <CODE>
  
  Explore cities in a country:
    protonvpn cities list <COUNTRY>
